why: An intent contract IS the definition that produced an answer. A durable read receipt names its version and digest so an old answer stays readable after the contract changes; if the bytes can move without the version moving, that promise is empty. Same mechanism as docs/release0/FROZEN_ARTIFACTS.json, and deliberately not a second framework.
changing_a_contract: bump version in the contract file
update the digest here IN THE SAME COMMIT
existing receipts are NOT rewritten - they name the old version on purpose
